## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew test` passes
- [ ] `./gradlew readme` was run, so the catalogue in README.md matches `questions/`

For a new or edited question:

- [ ] A real interviewer asks it, and the answer teaches a mechanism rather than a definition
- [ ] The wrong options are things a competent person might believe
- [ ] The `id` is new, or unchanged if the question already existed (progress files reference it)
- [ ] Where the answer depends on a JDK version, it says which

<!-- If you are correcting something, a link to the JDK source, JEP or javadoc that settles it is
     worth more than an argument. -->
